definitions.timingMigration: Prior-version visits retain an explicit elapsedOffset; categories sum to elapsed plus this offset
definitions.checkin: ticks receiving staffed check-in; paused check-in counts as waiting
definitions.selectionBias: Completed-only waits exclude people who departed or remain unfinished; consult all-outcome statistics too.

period.note: Period counts include visits carried in. Timing describes their whole visit, not just this period.
